note: Flaky tests: each failed and then passed on a rerun of the same tree. A quarantined test still runs in CI; a CI test task whose only failures are quarantined tests passes with a warning (scripts/ci-quarantine.mjs). An entry quarantines the test of that name in each of its files until its expiry date, then fails the run again. Keep the list short: fix the test, or renew the entry with new evidence. scripts/ci-flakes.mjs lists recent fail-then-pass reruns.
